title: Australian Pork Dumplings
description: A hearty and flavorful dish from Australia featuring pork dumplings in a savory broth.
instructions: Combine pork, onion, and garlic in a bowl and mix until just combined.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
Combine flour and a pinch of salt in a separate bowl.
Roll out each piece into a thin circle.
Place a tablespoon of the pork mixture in the center of each circle.
Fold the dough over the filling and press the edges together to seal.
Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Pan-fry the dumplings until golden brown on the bottom.
Add 2 cups of water to the skillet and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Serve the dumplings hot with sour cream and kicked chili sauce on the side.
